description: I am a neighbor, a friend, a husband and father, and your representative. I have been serving as your elected representative in the New York State Assembly for the past five years and it is my honor to serve. I have been a strong voice for investing tax dollars in local businesses and creating local jobs, rather than pandering to out-of-state businesses. Additionally, I have continued my fight to protect jobs in the agriculture industry and support our whole workforce.
title: Meet Brian | Brian D. Miller
